takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **75%** of 130 plays (n=98); also Wide (outside) 24% (n=31).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **9.2 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (shallower) (n=127, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Slot (75%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (7.6 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
